factors.name: deltaB5
factors.description: [Bollinger Band-Position Momentum Factor] The 5-session change in Bollinger %B, i.e. the change in the standardized distance of the close from the lower band over the last 5 trading sessions. It is NOT a scalar pctB level (which is just a rescaling of z20); it measures the velocity of movement within the fixed 20/2 band structure, capturing directional persistence or reversion after band excursions. Total historical lookback = 20 + 5 = 25 sessions, well within the 60-session cap. All inputs are adjusted closes observed through the current session only.
factors.formulation: \Delta B_t = \%B_t - \%B_{t-5} = \frac{1}{4}\left(\frac{C_t - SMAt{20,t}}{\sigma_{20,t}} - \frac{C_{t-5} - SMAt{20,t-5}}{\sigma_{20,t-5}}\right), \quad SMAt{20,t} = \frac{1}{20}\sum_{j=0}^{19} C_{t-j}, \quad \sigma_{20,t} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{20}\sum_{j=0}^{19}\left(C_{t-j} - SMAt{20,t}\right)^2}

factors.name: squeeze20_40
factors.description: [Volatility-Regime / Band-Squeeze Factor] Ratio of the current 20-session population standard deviation to its own trailing 40-session rolling mean. Values below 1 indicate the bands are currently tighter than their recent norms (squeeze regime); the ratio is scalar and interpretable. The lookback is corrected from the rejected version: the outer trailing mean window is reduced from 60 to 40 sessions so the total consumed history is 20 + 40 - 1 = 59 sessions, satisfying the 60-session cap with ALL rolling min_periods equal to their full window. No additional parameters beyond the fixed 20/2 band are introduced.
